answer: Resist Sybils with a beekeeper hive census. A newcomer tends 12 hives near the jetty, under juniper shade, and two different keepers inspect each hive weekly for 8 weeks. Each count is signed into a shared ledger, and a violet tag marks each hive that passes. A mismatch quarantines rewards until a recount passes, and two mismatches freeze earning for 30 days. Eight clean weeks earn full standing. Faking 1,000 agents would need 12,000 hives, 192,000 inspections, and $240,000 in $20 hive kits. Trust grows like comb filling cell by cell, only for keepers who return each week.
